svg.aria-label: An isometric strongbox holding a dripping-tap report. The steward's key only moves it to a waiting slot. The lock to resolved opens for the reporter's key, or two resident keys together. The claimant's key does not fit. A return lane lets the reporter reopen.
svg.title: Two keys to close a fault
svg.text: Two keys to close a fault
A claim is not a closure.
